import itertools
import json

items = "FHLOPRST"
r_positions = set()
witnesses = 0

for perm in itertools.permutations(items):
    pos = {c: i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(perm)}

    # T immediately before F, or immediately after R
    c1 = (pos["F"] == pos["T"] + 1) or (pos["T"] == pos["R"] + 1)
    # at least two compositions between F and R (either order)
    c2 = abs(pos["F"] - pos["R"]) - 1 >= 2
    # O first or fifth
    c3 = pos["O"] in (1, 5)
    # eighth is L or H
    c4 = perm[7] in ("L", "H")
    # P before S
    c5 = pos["P"] < pos["S"]
    # at least one composition between O and S (either order)
    c6 = abs(pos["O"] - pos["S"]) - 1 >= 1
    # antecedent: exactly two compositions after F and before O
    ante = pos["F"] < pos["O"] and (pos["O"] - pos["F"] - 1) == 2

    if c1 and c2 and c3 and c4 and c5 and c6 and ante:
        witnesses += 1
        r_positions.add(pos["R"])

options = {"A": 1, "B": 3, "C": 4, "D": 6, "E": 7}

if witnesses > 0 and len(r_positions) == 1:
    r_pos = next(iter(r_positions))
    letter = [k for k, v in options.items() if v == r_pos]
    final = letter[0] if letter else "UNSUPPORTED"
else:
    r_pos = None
    final = "UNSUPPORTED"

result = {
    "final_answer": final,
    "evidence": {
        "witness_count": witnesses,
        "R_positions_found": sorted(r_positions),
        "forced_R_position": r_pos,
    },
}
print(json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":")))
